name: Propiram
summary: Propiram (Algeril, Dirame, Bay 4503) is a partial μ-opioid receptor agonist and weak μ antagonist analgesic from the ampromide family of drugs related to other drugs such as phenampromide and diampromide. It was invented in 1963 in the United Kingdom by Bayer but was not widely marketed, although it saw some limited clinical use, especially in dentistry.

pharmacology.text: Propiram exhibits weak opioid antagonist activity on the μ receptor—quite a bit weaker than its agonist effects—and the effect on κ- and δ-opioid, σ-receptors, or the NMDA system are not well understood. Other drugs of the partial μ-opioid agonist/antagonist type include meptazinol, buprenorphine, butorphanol, phenazocine, nalbuphine, pentazocine, dezocine and its relatives.

uses.text: It was invented in 1963 in the United Kingdom by Bayer but was not widely marketed, although it saw some limited clinical use, especially in dentistry. Propiram reached Phase III clinical trials in the United States and Canada.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include dizziness, nausea, drowsiness and headache. As a partial opioid agonist it can bring on withdrawal in people dependent on other opioids, and it can itself lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 已知副作用包括頭暈、噁心、嗜睡和頭痛。作為部分鴉片促效劑，它可能使依賴其他鴉片類藥物的人出現戒斷，本身也可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知副作用包括头晕、恶心、嗜睡和头痛。作为部分鸦片促效剂，它可能使依赖其他鸦片类药物的人出现戒断，本身也可能导致依赖。

fact.en: Propiram belongs to the ampromide family of opioids, which are built on a flexible chain rather than the rigid ring system of morphine.
fact.zh: Propiram 屬於 ampromide 類鴉片，這類藥物以可彎曲的鏈狀結構為骨架，而不是嗎啡那種堅硬的環狀系統。
fact.zhHans: Propiram 属于 ampromide 类鸦片，这类药物以可弯曲的链状结构为骨架，而不是吗啡那种坚硬的环状系统。
